CustomField.label: Invitee Salutation
CustomField.description: ★R8 SEIM_INVITEE.SALUTE. Snapshot of the attendee's Salutation__c at the moment they were added, for the same reason as Invitee_Title__c: a name badge and a printed guest list are produced from the invitation, and reprinting one a year later should give the same words it gave the first time.
